      "path": "scripts/triage.sh",
      "content": "#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

log_file="${1:-}"

# Extract lines containing "ERROR", then strip timestamp and extract the error signature.
# Remove extra spaces, collapse multiple spaces, and ensure consistent formatting.
# Count occurrences of each unique signature and output "<count> <signature>" sorted by count desc.

# Use associative array to count signatures
declare -A counts

while IFS= read -r line; do
    # Skip non-ERROR lines
    [[ "$line" != *"ERROR"* ]] && continue
    # Remove timestamp (first 20 characters) and leading spaces
    signature="${line:20}"
    # Trim leading/trailing whitespace
    signature="$(echo "$signature" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]]*$//')"
    # Replace multiple spaces with a single space
    signature="$(echo "$signature" | tr -s ' ')"
    # Store back in array
    ((counts["$signature"]++))
done < "$log_file"

# Output results sorted by count descending
for sig in "${!counts[@]}"; do
    echo "${counts[$sig]} $sig"
done | sort -k1,1nr",
